{"note":"Unchanged fit geometry: no usable fit result was reported, so there is no evidence to justify tightening or loosening it. The 7.70 mm dimension is the retaining throat, not the main nut pocket; the pocket is 8.40 mm across flats. Print and check the coupon before committing to the knob. Finished assembly is one printed knob plus one M5 nut.","params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"knob_h":{"value":8.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_h":{"value":2.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bore_clearance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Diametral clearance."},"pocket_clearance":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Main hex pocket AF = nut_af + pocket_clearance."},"wall_t":{"value":1.1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_interference":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Retaining throat AF = nut_af - lip_interference."},"nut_axial_clearance":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_land_h":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"entry_af_clearance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_w":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_inner_r":{"value":3.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_outer_r":{"value":7.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"ring_inner_d":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_d":{"value":5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_radius":{"value":16.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_count":{"value":10,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    def hx(af,z,h):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z).polygon(6,af/math.cos(math.pi/6)).extrude(h)
    floor=p.floor_h
    top=p.knob_h
    af=p.nut_af+p.pocket_clearance
    lip=p.nut_af-p.lip_interference
    lip_z=floor+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_clearance
    ramp_z=lip_z+p.lip_land_h
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(top)
    for i in range(int(p.scallop_count)):
        a=2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_count
        cut=cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.scallop_radius*math.cos(a),p.scallop_radius*math.sin(a)).circle(p.scallop_d/2).extrude(top)
        body=body.cut(cut)
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=floor).circle(p.ring_inner_d/2).extrude(top-floor))
    socket=hx(af+2*p.wall_t,floor,top-floor)
    socket=socket.cut(hx(af,floor,lip_z-floor))
    socket=socket.cut(hx(lip,lip_z,p.lip_land_h))
    ramp=(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=ramp_z).polygon(6,lip/math.cos(math.pi/6)).workplane(offset=top-ramp_z).polygon(6,(p.nut_af+p.entry_af_clearance)/math.cos(math.pi/6)).loft())
    socket=socket.cut(ramp)
    for i in range(6):
        slot=(cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.slot_outer_r-p.slot_inner_r,p.slot_w,top-floor,centered=(True,True,False)).translate(((p.slot_outer_r+p.slot_inner_r)/2,0,floor)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),60*i))
        socket=socket.cut(slot)
    body=body.union(socket)
    return body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bore_clearance)/2).extrude(top))","print_orientation":"Flat bottom at z=0 on bed; socket and tabs upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut enters from top. Bolt axis is Z; bottom clearance hole allows bolt to emerge."},{"id":"socket_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    def hx(af,z,h):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z).polygon(6,af/math.cos(math.pi/6)).extrude(h)
    floor=p.floor_h
    top=p.knob_h
    af=p.nut_af+p.pocket_clearance
    lip=p.nut_af-p.lip_interference
    lip_z=floor+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_clearance
    ramp_z=lip_z+p.lip_land_h
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(floor)
    socket=hx(af+2*p.wall_t,floor,top-floor)
    socket=socket.cut(hx(af,floor,lip_z-floor))
    socket=socket.cut(hx(lip,lip_z,p.lip_land_h))
    ramp=(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=ramp_z).polygon(6,lip/math.cos(math.pi/6)).workplane(offset=top-ramp_z).polygon(6,(p.nut_af+p.entry_af_clearance)/math.cos(math.pi/6)).loft())
    socket=socket.cut(ramp)
    for i in range(6):
        slot=(cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.slot_outer_r-p.slot_inner_r,p.slot_w,top-floor,centered=(True,True,False)).translate(((p.slot_outer_r+p.slot_inner_r)/2,0,floor)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),60*i))
        socket=socket.cut(slot)
    return body.union(socket).cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bore_clearance)/2).extrude(top))","print_orientation":"Circular base at z=0 on bed; socket upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Optional fit test, not a component of the finished knob."}],"hardware":[{"id":"nut","ref":"ISO 4032 M5","qty":1}],"criteria":[{"id":"snap_retention","part":"knob","feature":"Six flexible walls and 7.70 mm AF retaining throat","relation":"engages","hardware":"nut","params":["nut_af","lip_interference","wall_t","slot_w","knob_h","floor_h"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"socket_coupon","description":"Align flats and press nut in by thumb only. Must seat without cracks or permanent tab spreading, then remain captured when inverted and gently shaken. Fit has not yet been verified."}},{"id":"hex_drive","part":"knob","feature":"8.40 mm AF main hex socket","relation":"contains","hardware":"nut","params":["nut_af","pocket_clearance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"socket_coupon","description":"Seated nut must not turn continuously in socket under hand torque. Slight rotational play is acceptable."}},{"id":"floor_stop","part":"knob","feature":"Solid floor surrounding bolt clearance hole","relation":"supports","hardware":"nut","params":["floor_h","bolt_d","bore_clearance","nut_af"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"socket_coupon","description":"Seated nut must bear on floor and cannot be pushed through it by hand."}},{"id":"recessed_nut","part":"knob","feature":"Nut below top surface and beneath retaining lips","relation":"contains","hardware":"nut","params":["nut_h","floor_h","knob_h","nut_axial_clearance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"socket_coupon","description":"Verify all six lips overlap nut and nut sits entirely below knob top."}},{"id":"bolt_passage","part":"knob","feature":"5.60 mm through-hole","relation":"clears","clearance_mm":0.3,"params":["bolt_d","bore_clearance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"socket_coupon","description":"Thread an M5 bolt through the nut by hand; confirm its end emerges through the bottom without rubbing or binding on plastic."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print socket_coupon first: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, 4 wall loops, 5 top/bottom layers and 40% infill. Base on bed, no supports. Slow down for the small socket walls; let the print cool fully.","parts":["socket_coupon"],"tool":"Slicer and printer"},{"n":"2","text":"Clear strings from the slots and hole. Align the nut flats with the socket and thumb-press straight down until fully seated beneath all six lips. Do not hammer or use a vise. Check that it stays in when inverted and gently shaken, cannot rotate continuously, and cannot pass through the floor. Check bolt passage. Do not treat an untested coupon as a passed fit test.","parts":["socket_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"If too stiff or tabs crack, reduce lip_interference by 0.1 mm and reprint the coupon. If the nut falls out, increase lip_interference by 0.1 mm and recheck. If the main hex pocket binds after insertion, increase pocket_clearance by 0.1 mm. Change one setting at a time. Reject cracked or permanently spread tabs.","parts":["socket_coupon"]},{"n":"4","text":"Print knob using successful coupon parameters and the same print settings. Keep bottom face on bed and socket upward; no supports. Cool and inspect tabs and slots.","parts":["knob"],"tool":"Slicer and printer"},{"n":"5","text":"To reuse the test nut, push it gently from below while easing the coupon tabs outward; sacrifice the coupon if necessary, keeping tools away from fingers. Align the nut flats and thumb-press it into knob until seated. Confirm it is recessed and retained upside down. No glue is required.","parts":["socket_coupon","knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"Thread onto your M5 bolt or stud by hand; the bolt can extend through the bottom hole. Tighten using the outer grip. Stop if the nut turns in the plastic or any wall cracks. Intended for modest hand-tightening loads, not safety-critical clamping. Keep away from heat and avoid sustained high loads because PLA can creep.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
